examples: Rain has an effect on plants.

more.def: A change that is caused by something.
examples: The medicine had a good effect.
Rain has a big effect on the garden.
The loud sound had an effect on the dog.
It takes effort to learn to read.
Cleaning my room took a lot of effort.

more.def: The energy and hard work you use to do something.
examples: With a lot of effort, they pushed the heavy sled up the hill.
The whole team made an effort to welcome the new player.
It took real effort to carry the canoe to the lake.
